name: PETRONAS Chemicals Group Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为季度业绩、年度报告与股息派发安排，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收7903000000.0 MYR，同比增长22.8%；净利润414000000.0 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, annual reports and dividend arrangements, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction, divestment or contract wins for any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 7,903,000,000.0, up 22.8% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 414,000,000.0.
